主要内容: This report is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, a Canadian financial institution, detailing the issuance of various senior global medium-term notes. The filing includes information about the reverse convertible notes linked to Cliffs Natural Resources Inc. and direct investment notes linked to the EquityCompass Equity Risk Management Strategy. The notes were priced on March 5, 2012, and settled on March 8, 2012, with principal amounts of $500,000 and $4,500,000 respectively. The report also includes legal opinions from Norton Rose Canada LLP and Morrison & Foerster LLP regarding the validity of the notes under Canadian and New York law. The filing is part of the Bank’s shelf registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-171806).
